sources.title: llama.cpp-v100 2.0.2: V100 (SM70) fork — 11,240 tok/s 200K ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: Next release work is already underway on hybrid PP=2 × intra-island TP+EP, ordered FP32 NVLink fused AllReduce+Residual+RMSNorm, and async PLE prefetching to push speculative decode past 200+ tok/s for both MoE and dense 27B. Feedback, benchmarks on other V100 setups (PCIe, SXM2, mixed VRAM, x86, AC922), issues, and PRs are all very welcome!
